# Kenney Nature Kit (subset)

- **Source:** https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit  
- **License:** CC0 1.0 (see `License.txt`) — commercial OK; credit optional  
- **Use:** Mini-MVP nature border around the playable field (PLACEHOLDER / prototype)  
- **Runtime copies:** `Assets/Resources/Environment/Kenney/*.fbx` (loaded by `MiniMvpApp`)

Only a curated subset is imported (trees, rocks, stumps, bushes). Full pack stays out of the repo to keep size down.
